g.text: a) Unscrew the four screws in each side of the pump
b) Unplug the already installed hose and remove it
c) Reinstall the cover so that it's rotated 90 degree
and the inlets are pointing outward along
the long side of the pump
d) Pay attention to the rubber gaskets while installing
the cap so that it's alligned properly
a) 拧下泵两侧的四个螺丝
b) 拔下已安装的软管并将其拆下
c) 重新安装盖子，使其旋转 90 度，
并且进水口朝向泵的长边外侧
d) 安装盖子时注意橡胶垫圈，
